Nina: Hey team — tiny life update! Were throwing a surprise baby shower for Cara on June 2 after work in the kitchen area 389
Nina: Quick asks: volunteers for food, cards, and a small gift? Keeping it casual.
Diego: I can handle savory platters and pickup 35f
Cara: (not an organizer :) Im mostly busy those evenings but will pop by early if stealth allows haha
People Ops (Maya): Ill organize the card and set a budget for a group gift. Suggested per-person $20-30?
Liam: happy to contribute $25. Also can bring non-alcoholic punch.
ConfettiBot: Suggested contributors: 10 -> $25 each -> Total $250. Create collection link?
Nina: Love it. Diego + Liam + Maya volunteering. Who wants to handle cake?
Diego: I can grab a sheet cake from the bakery next door. Dietary note: one vegan slice ok?
People Ops (Maya): Adding vegan option. Ill post a short RSVP + contribution link by tomorrow.
Nina: Please keep totally quiet — Cara thinks its a desk lunch.
Cara: omg stop everyone 602 (Im terrible at surprises)
Liam: :zipper_mouth_face:
People Ops (Maya): Draft card message: "So much love for you and the little one! 497 f490 Love, your Redwood pals" OK?
Diego: perfect.
Nina: If anyone remote wants to send a video clip (10-15s), DM me and Ill compile.
Liam: will do. Congrats Cara!! 
People Ops (Maya): RSVP list (edit): Nina, Diego, Liam, Maya, Priya, Kofi
Nina: Final note 389: Stealth mode engaged. Thanks team!
